name: Chewing Tobacco
overview: Scripture calls believers to live in obedience to God's commandments and to honor Him with their bodies as a living sacrifice, which includes avoiding practices that harm our health or defile us. The Lord promises healing and protection to those who diligently obey His statutes, reminding us that our physical well-being is connected to our spiritual faithfulness. Turning away from any form of idolatry or harmful habits is essential, as is putting on Christ and refusing to gratify the desires of the flesh. Loving Jesus means keeping His commandments, which encompasses caring for our bodies in a way that pleases God.
